$comment: The Model Market (a stall on every island; Gilda's on Port Meridian runs Q1.A): a Copilot-app-only mechanic. You hire a model (Auto, or a category's model with an effort) for each job on her board, paying starfish; the grade (right-sized, over, short) is the game's, against the course's guidance on models and reasoning effort. The jobs, prices, refunds, stamps, quotes and the keepers' lines are the pack's market.json; the model list is models.json; this file is the market's words: the overlay, the hire's name, each outcome's summary, the stall's signs and Wingman's hints.

text.summary.quick-right: {who} did the job for {paid} starfish: right-sized.
text.summary.quick-over-model: {who} did the job, but it cost {paid} starfish for a {fair}-starfish job.
text.summary.quick-over-effort: {who} did the job, but High effort cost {paid} starfish for a {fair}-starfish job.
text.summary.hard-right: {who} got it done: right-sized for a hard job.
text.summary.hard-short-auto: Auto made a start, but with its effort hidden, the job isn’t done.
text.summary.hard-short-model: {who} made a start, but a Lightweight model isn’t enough for this job.
text.summary.hard-short-effort: {who} made a start, but it needs more effort for this job.
text.interact: Hire a model at {keeper}’s Model Market
text.retryModelNotice: Retry with a different model: same job, and you don’t write it again. {model} fell short, so you pick another.
text.retryEffortNotice: Retry with more effort: same job, same model, and you don’t write it again. You choose the effort.
text.hint1: Read the job first, Captain. A quick look doesn’t need a big model. A hard job wants more muscle and effort.
text.hint2: I’ll mark a hire that fits each job. Open {keeper}’s work order and look for the glow.
text.hint3: Quick looks: Auto, or a Lightweight model on its default effort. Hard jobs: a Powerful model, or a Versatile one on High effort.
text.speaker: {keeper}:
text.title: {keeper}’s Model Market
text.sub: Hire a model for the job. Bigger models cost more starfish.
text.specialText: the app chooses a model for your task.
text.short: You’ve got {n}. Auto and Lightweight cost {price}, or find more starfish round the islands.
text.noRefundOver: Job done, no refund: you paid for more than it needed.
text.noRefundShort: No refund. Retry costs a new hire, but you won’t write the job again.
text.announceBoard: {keeper}’s Model Market. You have {n} starfish to spend. Pick a job, 1 to 4.
text.retryAutoNotice: Retry with Auto off: same job, and you don’t write it again. Pick a model, then set its effort.
text.retryUsed: That’s what you hired last time. Pick a different one.
text.retryEffortUsed: That’s the effort you used last time. Choose another (or another model).
text.retryPickFirst: Pick a model first (1–4), then its name.
text.retryPickModel: {model} fell short last time. Pick a size, then a different model.
text.retryPickAfterAuto: Auto’s off for this Retry. Pick a model, then set the effort dial.
text.hintRetry: It’s a Retry, Captain: same job, no new prompt. The choice is yours: pick a different model or a different effort, then sign.
text.fair: Right-sized: you paid a fair price{doubloons}.
text.announceRetryModel: {title}. Retry: choose a different model. You have {purse} starfish.
text.announceRetryEffort: {title}. Retry: choose the effort. You have {purse} starfish.
